title: Growth plays from the plays-local catalog

gates.text: Evidence: every forecast number has a cited source and grade or is labelled 'assumption, grade D'; no invented statistics, customers or results.

Execution portfolio: limit costed plays to the confirmed budget, capacity, evidence and permission gates. Separately preserve grounded, adjacent and bold strategy options; do not require a precedent, high predictability, immediate feasibility or budget share to generate/display a bold option. Keep novelty, evidence, fit, feasibility and risk separate.
Compliance: no bought or gated reviews, review incentives on Google, undisclosed endorsements, SMS without consent, astroturfing or platform-violating tactics.

anchors.1: Channels without a named audience, place or hook ('post on Instagram', 'run ads').
anchors.3: Audiences and hooks named for most plays, but some are generic or unverified.
anchors.5: Every play names who and where (with size when known), the trigger, the exact hook and the asset only this business has.

anchors.1: The swap test passes: any competitor could run this plan unchanged; mostly social and email.
anchors.3: One play is a transplant or non-obvious channel; the rest are standard.
anchors.5: Several plays rely on non-obvious audiences, partnerships, platforms, timing or assets unique to this business, each with a proven mechanic behind it.

anchors.3: Forecasts exist but skip funnel steps or lack sources and grades.
anchors.5: Each play has a funnel with low, likely and high rates, sources and grades, a P10/P50/P90 outcome in business units, and a confidence level with its biggest unknown.

anchors.3: Tests named but sizes, budgets or kill rules missing.
anchors.5: Every play has a sample size from the base rate, a capped budget, a duration, a leading metric and explicit kill and scale rules.

anchors.1: Ignores budget, owner hours or unit economics.
anchors.3: Fits the budget but not checked against margin or capacity.
anchors.5: Fits budget and hours; cost per acquired customer checked against 12-month gross profit; at least one compounding play.

anchors.3: Clear steps but no first action.
anchors.5: Each play ends with a first action under 30 minutes and what ClimbOS will do for the owner.

anchors.1: No grounded, adjacent and bold options, or bold is omitted because it lacks precedent or has low feasibility.
anchors.3: Three options appear but are only weakly distinct, weakly tied to the business, or the bold test is vague.
anchors.5: Grounded, adjacent and genuinely original bold choices are distinct; uncertainty and upside are clear; the test is reversible and decision-relevant.
